clue.text: Possessing the vocabulary for quarrelling?

definitions.meaning: literally owning a stock of terms to use
an idiom for arguing heatedly with someone

explanation.surface: A wry question: does knowing plenty of words equip you for a row?
explanation.definitionFit: Literally the phrase means owning terms; idiomatically it means exchanging angry remarks in a dispute.

clue.text: Literary drudge observed that it has strong teeth

parts.note: a hack is a writer who churns out dull work for pay
saw means observed, past tense of see

explanation.surface: A tired writer noticed something with a fierce bite.
explanation.definitionFit: This metal-cutting tool has a blade lined with hard fine teeth.

clue.text: Tree lined street not a meeting place

indicators.note: the word not tells us to leave something out of the street, here the article that follows it

parts.note: an avenue is a broad street, typically lined with trees

explanation.surface: A leafy boulevard is said not to be somewhere people gather.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering location for an event or match, such as a hall or stadium.

clue.text: Our lady in Paris

parts.note: read both as the French title for the Virgin Mary and as the famous Gothic cathedral on the Île de la Cité

explanation.surface: A reference to the Virgin Mary as honoured in the French capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase translates as the title of the Virgin Mary and names the great cathedral of Paris.

clue.text: Fold paper around a shawl

definitions.meaning: to enclose a present by folding paper over it
a garment draped over the shoulders, also called by this noun

explanation.surface: Instructions for wrapping a gift scarf in paper.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means enclose in a covering such as gift paper; the noun is a loose shoulder garment.

clue.text: Covered the brickwork then submitted an account

definitions.meaning: builders coat a wall with plaster or cement, which has this term
to present a bill or report formally

explanation.surface: A builder plastered a wall and then sent in the invoice.
explanation.definitionFit: Plasterers coat walls with a layer called this; one also presents bills or reports, using the same verb.

clue.text: Unhappy at following a past president

parts.note: sad means unhappy

explanation.surface: Someone is dismayed at coming after a former head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: Anwar Sadat was President of Egypt from 1970 until his assassination in 1981.
explanation.definitionFit: Anwar Sadat led Egypt as head of state in the 1970s.

clue.text: Sunday neckwear, say, for a learned person

indicators.note: say signals that we want a word that sounds like the phrase before it

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for Sunday, and neckwear is a collar, giving S plus COLLAR

explanation.surface: Wearing one's best collar on the Sabbath makes one look erudite.
explanation.definitionFit: An academic or erudite man or woman, devoted to study.

clue.text: Be clearly visible but refuse to agree

definitions.meaning: to hold out against a proposal or settlement

explanation.surface: A striker who is conspicuous but won't sign the deal.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to be conspicuous and to hold out in resistance to terms.

clue.text: Force to study music

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn by heart
a strain is a passage of melody

explanation.surface: Someone is compelled to practise their pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To compel or oblige someone, synonyms that both mean making them act against their will.

clue.text: Excavation said in France to be by the church

parts.note: dit is French for said
CH is the abbreviation for church

explanation.surface: A dig reported abroad to be near a place of worship.
explanation.definitionFit: A trench dug in the ground, typically for drainage, is a kind of dug-out channel.

clue.text: Joint holder

parts.note: reads like a co-owner, but means something that holds a joint of meat for roasting

explanation.surface: It sounds like a co-owner of property.
explanation.definitionFit: A long pin pierces and holds meat in place for roasting.

clue.text: Guard posted another line

parts.note: sent means posted, as a letter

indicators.note: read as an other form, the next word appears in different order

explanation.surface: A security guard was dispatched to another spot in the queue.
explanation.definitionFit: A soldier or sentry stationed to keep watch.

clue.text: Home of the brave?

parts.note: echoes the US anthem, but a brave is a Native American warrior, so this is his dwelling

explanation.surface: A phrase from the American national anthem.
explanation.definitionFit: A dome-shaped dwelling of bark or hides used by some Native American peoples.

clue.text: Flower suffering from poor drainage

indicators.note: something suffering from poor condition is in a mess, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plant wilting because its soil is waterlogged.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrub with fragrant white blooms, named after Alexander Garden.

clue.text: To live and work to criticise harshly

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
labour means work

explanation.surface: A motto about existence and toil, turned into an attack.
explanation.definitionFit: To attack someone verbally at length, or to argue a point excessively.

clue.text: Cora happy about the books

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so the name and the adjective are rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Cora is cheerful about her reading.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical writings excluded from the Hebrew canon, a set of texts of uncertain authority.

clue.text: Morass of papers about the meeting

indicators.note: the papers go about, or around, the meeting

parts.note: a quire is a set of 24 or 25 sheets of paper
AGM is short for annual general meeting

explanation.surface: Bureaucrats get bogged down in documents about a meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A bog or swamp, and figuratively an awkward, entangling situation.

clue.text: On which to cook at an open-air party

definitions.text: On which to cook at an open-air party

parts.words: On which to cook at an open-air party
parts.note: describes the grill used outdoors, which shares its name with the party itself

explanation.surface: A description of the cooking equipment at a garden gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: An outdoor grill, and the open-air meal cooked on it, share one name.

clue.text: It was a wonder the gardens were suspended here

definitions.text: It was a wonder the gardens were suspended here

parts.words: It was a wonder the gardens were suspended here
parts.note: refers to the Hanging Gardens, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World

explanation.surface: Amazement that a garden could hang in the air.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Mesopotamian city famed for its Hanging Gardens, listed among the Seven Wonders.

clue.text: Left one with a Shakespearean role

parts.note: port is the left side of a ship
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An actor departed with a part in a Shakespeare play.
explanation.walkthrough: Portia is the heroine of The Merchant of Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: The rich heiress who disguises herself as a lawyer in The Merchant of Venice.

clue.text: Like members of RU team

parts.note: rugby union players were for over a century unpaid, unlike professionals

explanation.surface: A description of the players in a rugby union side.
explanation.walkthrough: RU is rugby union, which banned payment to players until 1995.
explanation.definitionFit: Unpaid, as players in rugby union were until the game went professional in 1995.

clue.text: Damage beaker badly with silver inside

indicators.note: the silver goes inside the rearranged letters
badly suggests the word beaker is mangled, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Someone harms a lab beaker clumsily, with silver in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Damage' looks like a verb on the beaker, but it is the noun definition; 'with' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Smashed or broken items, or the act of breaking them.

clue.text: Kelvin points to officer that prayed

parts.note: K is the symbol for kelvin, the unit of temperature
N and E are compass points, north and east
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant

explanation.surface: Lord Kelvin directs a lieutenant who said his prayers.
explanation.definitionFit: Going down on one's knees is the posture of someone at prayer.

clue.text: Country song about a sailor

indicators.note: the song goes about, or around, the sailor

parts.note: an aria is a solo song in an opera
AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor

explanation.surface: A country-and-western ballad about a seaman.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arabian peninsula, historically called a land or country of the Middle East.

clue.text: Infant left scene of confusion

parts.note: a babe is a baby

explanation.surface: A baby was abandoned amid chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: From the biblical tower where languages were confounded, a noisy place of muddle.

clue.text: Sound come-back

definitions.meaning: a noise returning off a surface

explanation.surface: A healthy return to form.
explanation.definitionFit: A reflected noise repeated back to the hearer, literally a sound that comes back.

clue.text: Learning about one European river

indicators.note: the learning goes about, or around, the numeral

parts.note: lore is traditional knowledge or learning
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Study concerning a single continental waterway.
explanation.definitionFit: France's longest waterway, flowing west into the Atlantic past many châteaux.

clue.text: Disqualified fashionable international who was fit

parts.note: in means fashionable
a cap is awarded to a player chosen for a national team
able means fit or capable

explanation.surface: A trendy international player who had been fit is ruled out.
explanation.definitionFit: Legally unqualified or unable, lacking the competence required.

clue.text: One who counts all the holes, of course, and doesn't touch a drop

definitions.text: One who counts all the holes, of course
definitions.meaning: a golfer totalling the tees on the course, a punning reading
one who abstains completely from alcohol

explanation.surface: A golfer who adds up scores and never drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who totals the tees on a golf course, punningly, and an abstainer from alcoholic drink.
